player_prompt.intro: Ị na-egwu egwuregwu ọnụ ọgụgụ Countdown! Ihe mgbaru ọsọ: Jikọta nọmba site na iji +, -, *, / iji ruo ihe mgbaru ọsọ. Ụdị omume: [i j op] ebe i,j bụ indexes na op bụ ọrụ ahụ. Ihe atụ: [0 2 *] na-amụba nọmba na index 0 na nọmba na index 2. Nkewa ga-ebute naanị nọmba zuru ezu.

board.best: {observation} Nke kacha mma ruo ugbu a: {best_value} (anya: {distance}) Okwu kacha mma: {best_expression}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Invalid indices. Must be different and in range 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Ọrụ na-abaghị uru (nkewa site na efu ma ọ bụ nsonaazụ na-abụghị integer)
